articles.body:
What does one do in this situation?

At the beginning of a round the Elephants Tail is in Bombay facing Punjab.  However, before the Events in India phase we conquered Bombay.  What does one do if a Crisis Event is flipped in that scenario?

I hope that makes sense.

I don't have the rules in front of me for reference, but my recollection is that when you conquer a region with the elephant's tail, the elephant immediately moves to its center to threaten a rebellion.

Edit: pulled up the rules on my phone. Looks like I remembered right, see the "Elephant redirect" rule on page 23.

articles.body: Yep, if the Elephant's tail is ever now found to be in a company controlled region, move the elephant inside that region.  It will be an attack on the company.
